findings.title: No SSL path exists at all on this build, so it cannot be a TLS head end

limitations: All RCE in this corpus is RCE on the upstream host
methods: Control request first on the same config
Raw client bytes and raw upstream bytes captured in hex
Payload diffed against the control line

scope: Delivery amplification: two-hop proxy chains, cache-key control with a smuggled body, and TLS parity. Execution is on whichever host the chain terminates at.
